seo.title: AI File Organizer — Organize Local Files With Preview and Approval
seo.description: Organize, rename, and sort local files with an AI agent that previews the proposed structure before making approved changes on your computer.

hero.title: Describe the order you want. Preview it before anything moves.

features.title: More than moving files by extension.
features.description: Floatboat can use filenames, folder context, and document content to propose a structure that reflects the work itself.

items.question: Does the organizer upload my files?
items.answer: The workflow is designed around local folders on your computer. You choose the scope and can review the plan before approved file operations run.

items.question: Can it rename and move files together?
items.answer: Yes. A single approved plan can create folders, rename files, and move them into the proposed structure while reporting the result per file.

items.question: What happens when the agent is unsure?
items.answer: Uncertain matches should be surfaced for review rather than silently forced into a category. You can correct the plan before execution.

items.question: Can I reuse an organization system?
items.answer: Yes. A successful rule can become a reusable workflow for recurring exports, client onboarding, downloads, or project archives.
